\chapter{Form Retrieval at R2 and R3}
\label{ch:pa-form-r2-r3-retrieval}
\hlchaptermodality{26}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can retrieve the known three-field and work-field writing tasks at R2 and R3 without adding a new field, value, or script shape.}

The learner selects a known work value, hides the bank, writes one row after a short delay, and checks spelling, spacing, and field agreement.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[three-field no-model and repair …]{Three fields return at R2}

\label{lesson:PA-R26-three-repair-r2}



\begin{quote}
No new labels or values appear. Keep every bank closed and recall the order language, residence, work.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one no-model form}
Complete the three fields for cues B · A · B. Finish the whole attempt before checking anything.

\subsection*{Your turn — one bounded repair pass}
Compare selection, spelling, spacing, then placement. Repair only the first differing dimension. If the work row differs, repair that row only.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one form. This is retrieval, not a longer writing test.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field supported build at R3]{Rebuild one work row at R3}

\label{lesson:PA-R26-work-build-r3}



\begin{quote}
Read the three labels in order: \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ} · \pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼} · \pa{ਕੰਮ}}. Point to the work label and stop.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script and value recall}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ੌ}} once above \textbf{\pa{ਨ}}, making \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ}}. Then read the known value \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} once.

\subsection*{Writing — one supported work row}
Use the old bank once: \textbf{A — \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} and \textbf{B — \pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}.

Choose B. Complete \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}. Keep the bank visible for this one attempt.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One supported row is enough. The next lesson removes the bank after a short delay.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field delayed control at R3]{Hide, write, and check one work row at R3}

\label{lesson:PA-R26-work-control-r3}



\begin{quote}
Read the old work bank A — \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}, B — \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}. Select B, hide the bank, and count slowly to ten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one delayed row}
With the bank hidden, complete \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for B.

\subsection*{Your turn — four checks, no rewrite}
Reveal the model. Check the value piece by piece, the one space after the colon, and that the job value stayed on the work field. Repair only the first difference.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one delayed row. This closes the bounded R3 retrieval pass without adding a new form field.
\end{tcolorbox}
